Subject: Legal Notice for Breach of Contract 
Dear [Recipient's Full Name], 
We, the undersigned, act on behalf of our client, [Your Client's Full Name], residing at 
[Client’s Address], hereinafter referred to as “our client.” We have been instructed to issue 
this legal notice to you regarding the breach of contract dated [Date of Contract], executed 
between our client and you. 
1. Background 
On [Date of Contract], our client and you entered into a legally binding agreement 
regarding [brief description of the agreement, e.g., supply of goods/services, real estate 
transaction, partnership, etc.]. As per the terms and conditions of the contract: 
1. [Summarize the key obligations of the recipient] 
2. [Include any specific timelines, deliverables, or responsibilities agreed upon] 
Our client has diligently fulfilled all their obligations under the contract. However, you have 
failed to comply with the following obligations: 
1. [Detail the specific breaches, e.g., failure to deliver goods/services on time, failure 
to make payments, etc.] 
2. [Additional breaches, if any] 
2. Breach of Contract 
Your failure to comply with the terms of the contract constitutes a material breach, causing 
our client significant loss and damages. Despite our client’s repeated attempts to
contract.pdf::2:
communicate with you and resolve the issue amicably, you have failed to take any action to 
rectify the breach or compensate our client for the losses incurred. 
3. Relief Demanded 
In light of the above, we hereby demand that you: 
1. [Specify the action required, e.g., make payment of PKR [amount] within [number 
of days], deliver the goods/services as agreed, etc.] 
2. [Additional actions, if any] 
We urge you to take immediate action to fulfill your contractual obligations within [number 
of days, typically 7-15 days] from the date of receipt of this notice. Failing to comply will 
compel our client to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you, including but not 
limited to filing a suit for breach of contract, seeking damages, and any other relief deemed 
appropriate under Pakistani law. You will be held responsible for all costs incurred, including 
legal fees and court charges. 
4. Consequences of Non-Compliance 
If you fail to comply with this notice within the stipulated time, we will proceed to file a 
lawsuit against you in the competent court of law without any further notice. You will bear 
the full responsibility for all legal costs and damages resulting from this breach. 
This notice is being sent to you under instructions from our client and is without prejudice 
to our client's rights to initiate legal proceedings and seek any other remedies available 
under Pakistani law. 
Yours sincerely, 
[Your Name] 
[Lawyer’s Signature] 
[Designation] 
Pk-Legal and Associates 
[Contact Information] 
 
Important Notes: 
1. Proof of Delivery: Ensure this legal notice is sent through a reliable method that 
provides proof of delivery, such as registered mail or courier. 
2. Record Keeping: Keep copies of all related documents, including the contract, 
communications, and the proof of delivery, for future reference in legal proceedings.
